Photorealistic straight-on architectural elevation of the main entrance of Yichang Guomao Mall (宜昌国贸大厦, the curved granite podium on Dongshan Avenue), at night, filling a wide 1536x544 banner from edge to edge: no pavement, no sky, no canopy soffit, no building above.

Use the three reference photographs only for the real building's construction, materials and light: the pink-beige banded granite portal and its two square polished-granite piers; the tall dark bronze-framed glass doors; the luxury ground-floor hall behind the glass (cosmetics counters, warm display lighting, cream stone floor, curved white ceiling); the wet night street reflections. Do not copy their camera angle, their temporary red banners, their red opening arch, their Christmas cone, their poster boards or their people.

Composition: five equal full-height glass door leaves side by side, centred, occupying about 88% of the width, with narrow polished pink-granite piers at the far left and right edges. Each leaf is clear glass in a slim dark bronze aluminium frame with a vertical brushed-bronze pull handle; a horizontal bronze transom rail crosses all five leaves at about three quarters of their height, with a narrow glass transom row above it. The door heads and the transom line stay perfectly level; verticals stay parallel (flat orthographic elevation, no keystone distortion, no vanishing point). The centre leaf sits exactly on the horizontal centre of the frame.

Behind the glass: a real Chinese luxury-mall ground floor, not a hotel lobby. Warm 3000K ceiling downlights in a curved white ceiling, illuminated glass cosmetics counters with pale stone tops and small product rows, a few tall slender display cabinets, polished cream-grey stone floor with soft vertical reflections, a hint of a distant escalator. No reception desk, no potted palms, no lounge chairs, no marble hotel wall.

Light and surface: night interior-to-exterior ratio, warm interior against a cool blue-grey exterior. The glass carries restrained wet-street reflections and fine rain beads, strongest on the two outer leaves, never hiding the interior. Moderate exposure: interior highlights keep detail, no clipped white ceiling, no blooming lamps, no yellow colour cast. Realistic 35mm architectural photograph, sharp frames and stone grain, subtle depth inside.

No readable text, no lettering, no signage, no brand logos, no watermark, no people, no vehicles, no promotional banners.
